verifications.claim: NASA launched the Artemis II mission on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'blasted off from Florida on Wednesday evening' (URL: 2026/04/01); R2: 'on April 1, 2026 at 6:35pm ET'; R3: 'on Wednesday, April 1'; R4/R5: launch details match April 1, 2026 context.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the exact date and successful launch.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission sent four astronauts on a 10-day journey around the moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'lifting four astronauts toward space... around the moon'; R2: '4 astronauts... 10-day journey'; R3: '10-day deep-space journey'; R4/R5: '4 astronauts... 10-day mission around the moon'.
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly state 4 astronauts on a 10-day lunar flyby mission.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission marks the first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first crewed mission to the moon in more than 50 years'; R2: 'first time in over 50 years'; R3: 'first crewed mission... since Apollo 17 in 1972'; similar in others.
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently describe it as first crewed lunar mission since Apollo 17 (1972), over 50 years.
